title: parasenecio koualapensis
intro: Parasenecio koualapensis, commonly known as Kouala, is a plant species within the sunflower family native to Hawaii. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can be attributed to its therapeutic actions in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as its ability to protect against cell damage and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Kouala include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Further research is necessary to fully understand the efficacy and safety of Kouala as a therapeutic agent.
